name: Prompt Glow
description: A band of water-blue light that circles the composer's border while the agent works, with a faint glow under its lower edge.

props.name: active
props.description: Runs the band. It eases in, and when switched off it slows as it fades. Sets aria-busy on the wrapper while on.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the wrapped box in pixels, so the band follows its border.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per lap. The band travels at an even speed along the edges and round the corners.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the band and glow. The head of the band is mixed toward the text colour: deeper by day, brighter at night.

props.name: children
props.description: The box to circle, usually a PromptBox. It should fill the wrapper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper. Other div props are spread onto it.
